job: Folding one-pass low-bit quantized export and a bundled auto-swapping inference server into the training toolkit's core release path.
outcome: A documented train, one-pass low-bit export, and serve flow driven from one tool with a bundled checkpoint-switching model server.
motivation: Local and small-team users treat separate train, export, and serve tools as friction the toolkit can absorb to stay the default.

task.what: wire quantized-export-to-serve into one continuous flow
task.where: the toolkit's training pipeline and release branch
task.when: runway from this beta through H1 2027
task.why: make integrated export-to-serve the stock local workflow
task.how: one-pass GGUF/adapter export plus bundled auto-swap server

job: Making a llama-swap-style server embeddable inside tuning toolkits, auto-switching checkpoints and doing memory-aware load/unload out of the box.
outcome: A first-party or bundled model server that handles checkpoint switching and idle-unload/reload, shipped as a toolkit feature not a separate stack.
motivation: As the raw single-box loop commoditizes, embedding the server keeps it relevant and cedes the standalone-server slot on the local tier.

task.what: bundle auto-swapping memory-aware server into tuning toolkit
task.where: the toolkit's serve module and export handoff
task.when: runway between this beta and H1 2027
task.why: carry serving as a toolkit feature, not a product

job: Collapsing portable compressed low-bit weights, quantized GGUF, and adapter targets into a single one-pass export emitting ready-to-serve artifacts.
outcome: A training run that emits ready-to-serve quantized artifacts in one pass, feeding the bundled server without a hand-off to a separate stack.
motivation: One-pass export-to-serve removes the quantize-and-export middle tool, making the single-tool local loop the path of least resistance.

task.what: emit ready-to-serve low-bit artifacts in one pass
task.where: the toolkit's export stage feeding the server
task.why: eliminate the separate quantize-export hand-off step
task.how: unified low-bit, GGUF, and adapter one-pass export
